verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated Agentic Feed API for this story. Merchants upload product data in batches of up to 200 items, and the mapped data syncs to AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta, with one item able to target several platforms in a single request. Marketing materials also describe a single feed that adapts to each platform with real-time catalog and inventory data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence in the pack on feed schema, field mapping, and update or delete semantics.
